calls.head: The Blue Jackets will send their checkers at Tkachuk
calls.body: At home, the Blue Jackets keep sending Coyle’s line (Coyle, Olivier and Sillinger) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Rick Bowness has been using this group as a checking line on the other team’s top line. Tonight the Panthers’ first line is Bennett, M. Tkachuk and B. Tkachuk.

calls.head: Talbot’s hold on the Panthers won’t last
calls.body: Since 2023-24, Talbot has been a wall against the Panthers, well above his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if the Panthers finally get to him.

calls.head: Special teams lean toward the Panthers
calls.body: The Blue Jackets’ penalty kill is one of the league’s worst, and the Panthers’ power play is near the top. Discipline matters more than usual for the Blue Jackets tonight.

calls.title: The power play delivered
calls.plain: The Panthers’ power play created at least its usual chances. Florida went 4 for 6 on the power play.
calls.said: the Panthers’ power play would get its usual chances against the Blue Jackets’ shaky kill
calls.beyond: Florida has a better power play than most, and Columbus has one of the league’s leakiest penalty kills. Even by those standards, this was a big night: 4 power-play goals on 6 chances. A power play like theirs against a kill like Columbus’s scores 4 or more about once every 20 games.

surprises.head: Cam Talbot got lit up
surprises.body: Talbot allowed 6 goals on 23 shots, worth 2.6 expected goals: 3.4 more than expected. Starting goalies have a night this rough about once every 60 starts.

story.head: A natural hat trick for Brady Tkachuk
paras: Brady Tkachuk had a natural hat trick for the Panthers, three straight goals in the second period. His brother Matthew Tkachuk assisted on all three, and had five assists in all. Kent Johnson got the scoring started for the Blue Jackets late in the first. Brady Tkachuk scored his first goal for Florida early in the second to tie it 1-1. Brady Tkachuk scored later in the period and again 4:30 later on the power play to put the Panthers up 3-1. Carter Verhaeghe scored twice and Sam Reinhart once in a 5:38 span late in the second to make it 6-1. Columbus pulled Cam Talbot after six goals and turned to Jet Greaves in the third. Denton Mateychuk and Cole Sillinger scored 22 seconds apart late in the third to cut it to 6-3. Reinhart scored again with 2:17 left into the empty net with 2:17 left. Reinhart also had an assist. Seth Jones finished with four assists.
The chances were closer than the score. Akira Schmid made 24 saves for the Panthers.
The Panthers scored four power-play goals on six chances. Mathieu Olivier was thrown out with a game misconduct late in the second. The Cats improved to 3-2-2, and the Blue Jackets dropped to 2-3-0.
